results.name: voted
results.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.author_id AS "authorId", p.category, p.tags, p.views, p.title,
  p.accepted_comment_id AS "acceptedCommentId", p.hidden_at IS NOT NULL AS hidden,
  p.created_at AS "createdAt", p.updated_at AS "updatedAt", jsonb_build_object('id', u.id, 'username', u.username, 'level', u.level) AS author,
  CASE WHEN pr.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('id', pr.id, 'slug', pr.slug, 'title', pr.title) ELSE NULL END AS problem,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_comments c WHERE c.post_id=p.id AND c.hidden_at IS NULL) AS "commentCount",
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_votes v WHERE v.post_id=p.id) AS "voteCount" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.author_id LEFT JOIN problems pr ON pr.id=p.problem_id AND pr.status='PUBLISHED'
        JOIN community_votes v ON v.post_id=p.id AND v.user_id=$1 WHERE (p.hidden_at IS NULL OR p.author_id=$1) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 100

results.name: saved
results.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.author_id AS "authorId", p.category, p.tags, p.views, p.title,
  p.accepted_comment_id AS "acceptedCommentId", p.hidden_at IS NOT NULL AS hidden,
  p.created_at AS "createdAt", p.updated_at AS "updatedAt", jsonb_build_object('id', u.id, 'username', u.username, 'level', u.level) AS author,
  CASE WHEN pr.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('id', pr.id, 'slug', pr.slug, 'title', pr.title) ELSE NULL END AS problem,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_comments c WHERE c.post_id=p.id AND c.hidden_at IS NULL) AS "commentCount",
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_votes v WHERE v.post_id=p.id) AS "voteCount" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.author_id LEFT JOIN problems pr ON pr.id=p.problem_id AND pr.status='PUBLISHED'
        JOIN community_saved s ON s.post_id=p.id AND s.user_id=$1 WHERE (p.hidden_at IS NULL OR p.author_id=$1) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 100
